verdict.rationale: No evidence pack item addresses telemetry/usage-tracking opt-out settings for Snowflake products (CLI, notebooks, MCP server, etc.); documentation focuses on RBAC, compliance certifications, and cost monitoring but not opt-out of usage/telemetry collection. missing for 10: any docs on telemetry collection practices, an opt-out flag/setting (e.g., CLI --disable-telemetry), or privacy documentation addressing usage tracking.
